# Breaking: Jensen er tilbage!

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-11-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Store Penge episode was recorded right after the news that Jensen Huang is returning as Nvidia CEO, roughly ten days after his removal. The press release says the board acted on input from senior US government officials. The hosts discuss whether markets have bottomed after a selloff of about 10% on the Nasdaq. Joachim (Plus & Markets) calls it a long-term buying opportunity in fast-growing AI companies. Mikkel agrees on the long view but warns of short-term risks over the next 2-4 months: an open probe into Nvidia's accounting, an expected rate hike, a 10-year yield near 5%, US debt worries and a possible government shutdown on 11 December. Other topics are the Anthropic IPO, which Joachim sees as reasonably valued, a weaker outlook for software/SaaS names, and Take-Two's GTA 6 launch, where the online conversion is seen as the key long-term driver.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Huang reinstated; AI firms sold off despite ~70% growth, seen as great entry point. Short-term risk from accounting probe and macro.

#### Reasoning

Guest Joachim thinks the market has bottomed. He says AI companies were slaughtered while revenue kept growing (Nvidia ~70% a year), which makes this a 'crazy entry point' for long-term holders. Host Mikkel agrees on a 5-10 year view. He notes that the open probe into Nvidia's accounting, an expected rate hike, the 10-year yield near 5% and a possible shutdown on 11 Dec could offer a better entry within 2-4 months. Huang's return was the 'optionality' the hosts had flagged.

#### Sell Triggers

- if accounting practice probe leads to adverse findings
- if US government shutdown/debt crisis escalates
- if AI revenue growth decelerates sharply
- if Huang leadership again disrupted

> *"Så hvis du har et selskab, der vokser aggressivt, og aktiekursen samtidig bliver smadret, så har du jo et helt vildt entry point ind i den her sektor"*

---

### 🟠 TTWO — Take-Two Interactive | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

GTA 6 record launch but stock -9%; the thesis depends on conversion to the paid online version (~1 yr out). Revisit nearer online launch.

#### Reasoning

The guest has studied the stock. Launch sales were expected and are not decisive. The long-term value depends on how many players move to the paid online mode, which is rumoured for about a year out. That makes the online launch the key catalyst, and they plan to revisit the stock as it approaches. No explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if online conversion is weak
- if player engagement fades quickly after launch peak
- if online version delayed

> *"det er mere det der skift over til online, man beder på, hvor godt det lykkes"*
